messages.author: a7999634d98380ca
messages.subject: TMB random effects model selection
parts:
Hi
I just started experimenting with random effects using the TMB engine and I found that if I run MuMIn's dredge function on a model that contains random effects, the REs are not retained in the fitted models. See example below.

Does anyone know if there is a way around this that doesn't involve manually fitting every model?

MuMIn::getAllTerms() only returns the fixed effects.

Thanks very much.

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: TMB random effects model selection
parts:
I haven't looked at the internals of dredge but it's possible that it just hasn't been updated to handle the random effects functionality in unmarked. You'd probably have to ask the MuMIn author if there is a workaround or some other setting.

I general I would recommend fitting a small handful of carefully chosen models corresponding to your specific hypotheses/predictions rather than an all-subsets/dredge approach to model selection.

Ken
